findings.title: Caching tests deleted with no replacement
findings.body: The "Caching" describe block was removed. The service still caches in `getAuthorizationConditions` and `getFilterConditions` through `cachedAuthConditions` and `cachedFilterConditions`. Nothing now checks that a second call returns the cached value, or that a cached `null` filter result is not rebuilt. Those tests could easily have been kept by comparing `Prisma.sql` objects. The removal looks like a side effect of the conversion rather than a deliberate decision.

findings.title: Behavior change in team scope and new empty-list branches have no tests
findings.body: The old team-scope condition always included the `userId IN [...]` branch, even when the user list was empty. The new code adds it only when `userIdsFromTeam.length > 0`, and the org scope has the same kind of conditional branch. The tests only cover cases where users exist. They do not cover a team with no members, an org with no child teams, a team that does not belong to the org (which should return `NOTHING_CONDITION`), or `getBaseConditions` when only one side is present. These are the authorization edge cases the PR checklist calls out as risky, and none of them is exercised.
